# Fixtures for `odt` (OpenDocument text)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. People, places,
companies and addresses (Saltmere, `example.org`, `*.example`) are fictitious.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `ferry-textutil.odt` | Converted by macOS `textutil` from `scripts/fixtures/documents/ferry.html` (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `macro.odt` | Assembled part by part by `scripts/fixtures/craft_documents.py` | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.odt` | Assembled part by part by `scripts/fixtures/craft_documents.py` | CC0-1.0 |
